acceptance: The user's choice (a, b, c, or another option) is recorded in context with date and the user's words
If (b) or (c) is chosen, pvm-s6-publish-polars-results is updated with the matching scope and acceptance before it is taken
If (c) is chosen, a separate item for the validation provider exists and pvm-s6-publish-polars-results lists it in needs
description:
Polars DataFrame bundles at SF10 cannot be ranked in Results Explorer. DataFrame validation returns UNCERTAIN (TPC-H outside SF1, TPC-DS) or NOT_RUN (SSB, ClickBench) (query_validation.py:89-101), and validate_corpus.py treats both as validation_not_clean (validate_corpus.py:41-42, 376). Unranked bundles also contribute no comparison identity to the cohort depth gate.

Options for the user:
(a) Recommended: publish the analysis and a blog post only; do not add bundles to results-data/.
(b) Promote the setup A median bundles unranked under results-data/bundles/polars-version-matrix/. This needs an explicit allowlist entry in validate_corpus.py (replacing the hard-coded duckdb-version-matrix check, not a suffix rule), plus spec and test updates.
(c) First build a DataFrame validation provider that turns cross-surface and row-count evidence into a clean status, so the bundles rank. This is a product change with its own spec and review, and it would be a new item.

Guardrail: no work in pvm-s6 starts until the user's choice is recorded here with date and wording. The decision can be taken at any time; it does not need to wait for the run.
